name: Padzilly Homes
description: Save properties from Zillow or Realtor to your Padzilly favorites

content_scripts._comment: Matches the whole site, not just detail URLs. Zillow and Realtor are SPAs: going from the search list into a listing changes the URL through the History API without a document load, so Chrome never injects a detail-only content script and the widget only showed up after a manual reload. content.js renders nothing until isPropertyDetailPage() says so, and its URL watcher adds/removes the widget as the user navigates.
